diagnosis.root_cause: Current RTL is structurally incomplete: gemm_core_seq, postproc_relu_bias, output_streamer, and local_memories are placeholder stubs, and top-level control depends on their done/stream signals. As a result, the FSM cannot complete a job and cocotb waits until timeout.

first_divergence.expected: test_directed_boundaries should advance through load/compute/emit and produce y transfers
first_divergence.observed: regression starts first test then stalls and ends in SIMULATION_TIMEOUT with no completed tests

evidence.observation: TIMEOUT in cocotb_regression at first test start.
evidence.relevance: Authoritative primary failure class is simulation timeout.

evidence.observation: Module body is placeholder comment only; no sequential MAC or done generation.
evidence.relevance: Compute phase cannot progress to completion.

evidence.observation: Module body is placeholder comment only; no finalize datapath/done behavior.
Module body is placeholder comment only; no y_valid/y_data/emit_done handling.
evidence.relevance: Egress cannot produce outputs or completion pulse.

evidence.observation: Module body is placeholder comment only; no storage/readback implementation.
evidence.relevance: No functional data path for load/compute/finalize/emit.

evidence.observation: FSM transitions depend on load_*_done/compute_done/finalize_done/emit_done and uses wildcard connections to submodules.
evidence.relevance: If submodule control outputs are unimplemented, top-level state machine stalls.

alternative_hypotheses: Potential handshake bug in input_loader could also stall ingress even after other blocks are implemented.

repair_plan.recommended_change: Implement the frozen architecture end-to-end with synthesizable sequential logic: (1) fully implement input_loader ready/valid sectioned ingest, address counters, load_done pulses, and wrong-section load_err behavior; (2) implement local_memories arrays and deterministic read/write muxing for A/B/bias/acc/Y paths; (3) implement gemm_core_seq single-MAC nested-loop engine with signed int8 multiply, int32 wrapped accumulation, and compute_done at 64 outputs; (4) implement postproc_relu_bias one-element-per-cycle bias add with int32 wrap then signed ReLU write to y_mem plus finalize_done; (5) implement output_streamer y_valid/y_data from y_mem, advance only on y_valid&&y_ready, hold stable under stall, assert emit_done after 64 accepted transfers, and generate done pulse timing through top FSM; (6) in top, replace fragile wildcard coupling with explicit port connectivity so control/data signals are deterministically driven and reset-safe.
do_not_change: Do not change frozen interface signal list, widths, polarity, or handshake semantics.
Do not alter job ordering (A then B then bias), output ordering (row-major), or done/error contract.
Do not modify test/reference artifacts or relax timeout/functional checks.
Do not change arithmetic semantics: int32 two's-complement wrap on accumulation and bias add before ReLU.
expected_side_effects: Latency should match contract baseline (plus output backpressure stalls).
Once implemented, timeout should convert to functional pass/fail assertions, enabling full checking.
